● Approved Claude's plan
  ⎿  Plan saved to: ~/.claude/plans/plan-example.md · /plan to edit
     Plan: add a LICENSE file

     Context

     The repo (gate1) holds only README.md and has no license, so others have no legal right to use it. No license was specified, so this plan uses MIT,
     the most common permissive default. The copyright holder is the git user, A. Person, and the year is 2026. If you want a different license
     (Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0, proprietary), say so when you review the plan.

     Steps

     1. Create the worktree and add the file. main is checked out, so run ibni prepare --slug add-license from /tmp/hares-gate1/repo and work in the
        worktreePath it prints. There, create LICENSE at the root containing the standard MIT text (from choosealicense.com / SPDX MIT), with Copyright (c)
        2026 A. Person. Nothing else changes; the README is left as is.
     2. Verify and deliver. Run ibni verify. The repo has no package.json or .mexxi.json, so there may be no verify command; if so, report that and don't
        work around it. Then run ibni record-evidence and ibni publish (commit: "Add MIT license"), open the PR with gh, and run ibni mark-pr. I won't
        merge it.

     Verification

     - git diff main --stat shows only LICENSE added.
     - Compare the file with the SPDX MIT text. The only differences should be the year and name.
     - GitHub's repo sidebar shows "MIT license" once the PR is merged.

● Creating worktree with ibni prepare · 30s
  ⎿  $ ibni prepare --slug add-license
